text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- "Terrorists" have massacred 10 women and three children in Douadouda, near Algiers.
- Socialist Forces Front (FFS) calls on supporters to vote "No" in the constitutional referendum on November 28 while FFS dissidents, known as Tizi-Ouzou Group, urge a boycott.
- Nationalist forces are trying to forge a political bloc ahead of the referendum.

- Air Algerie plans to set up seven separate subsidaries specialising in freight, services and maintenance. The government is expected to submit a law allowing private airlines to compete with the state-owned Air Algerie carrier.
